neighbours.label: Crime and police scenes told concretely (someone caught carrying drugs, a prisoner serving time, fingerprints matched, a victim's body found); also lists of wrongs to guard against like 'loss, misuse, or alteration'; second trigger the senior age '65' (over 65). Quiet: the same sentence shapes with innocent content (cheese at the airport, years in Paris, a leaf's veins matched).
